title: $100 Amazon Gift Card — Instant Digital Delivery
description: RewardVault US is releasing a limited batch of $100 Amazon gift cards to new US members this week. The code works on virtually anything sold on Amazon.com — electronics, groceries, household essentials, and more.

There's no purchase required to qualify. Registration takes about two minutes: your name, a valid US mailing address, and an email for the confirmation link. A short set of optional preference questions follows, which you're free to skip.
Codes are issued electronically once your profile is verified, usually within minutes to a few hours. Limited to US residents 18 and older, one claim per household.
